title: Supplement to "A Bidirectional Threat Model for AI-Agent Integration Across Federated Identity Boundaries": corpus, codebook, and elicitation matrix
description: Companion material for the short paper by J. Dunne and S. Uludag at IEEE IPCCC 2026 (Austin, TX, November 2026). It holds what the six-page limit could not: the 21-incident corpus with per-incident coding, the codebook and the search and screening protocol, the 31-row STRIDE/LINDDUN elicitation matrix, the eight candidate NIST SP 800-53 control enhancements with the binding-and-parsing trio, the EchoLeak trace, and a script that reproduces the paper's corpus counts from the data file. Provisional items are marked as such in the README and the validation report.
